scope: Stop treating writer-canonical LTYPE handles as a source-format invariant, then qualify strict AC1024 DWG-to-DXF output and fresh DXF readback for the existing mechanical sample.

authority.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.rule: Numentries excludes BYBLOCK and BYLAYER; control handles list the linetypes with the two special entries last; the ordinary entries are soft-owner references and the BYBLOCK/BYLAYER entries are hard-owner references. The section does not assign numeric handles to the named LTYPE rows.
authority.remaining_conflict: The ODA text says BYLAYER then BYBLOCK; the physical ODA-produced profiles in p6-dwg-ltype-control-order-roles-2026-11-04.json show BYBLOCK then BYLAYER. The validator continues to accept either final-slot order and makes no producer-order claim.

source.fixturePolicy: Existing local sample; no DWG or DXF fixture was added to Git.

implementation.defect: The source LTYPE membership gate compared BYBLOCK, BYLAYER and CONTINUOUS row handles with constants used by this library's DWG writer. The physical sample uses 0x14, 0x15 and 0x16 for those names, so strict-complete export was refused before the output inspectors could validate the source graph.
implementation.correction: Match each ordered LTYPE_CONTROL handle to exactly one typed row owned by the control; require unique names; require the named BYBLOCK and BYLAYER rows to occupy the final two phantom slots in either order; require named CONTINUOUS in a counted slot. Numeric source handles remain source-specific.

coverage: Noncanonical source handles 0x14/0x15/0x16 and 0x1B1 are accepted when typed names, owner and final phantom slots agree.
Either final BYBLOCK/BYLAYER slot order is accepted.
A special phantom placed among counted slots, missing BYBLOCK, wrong owner, missing target, duplicate name, null slot, duplicate publication and stale generation are refused.
